title: The World Under Siege
summary: Dreadnoughts descend on every continent. Ha-Jun cleaves the flagship over Seoul in a single titanic stroke, while Tae-Jun holds the line in the upper stratosphere.

panels.shot: global satellite view of earth surrounded by thousands of red portal rifts
panels.action: From orbit, Earth looks ensnared in a web of bleeding red cracks; smoke plumes rise from sixty world capitals.
panels.prose_en: From orbit, Earth looks ensnared in a web of bleeding red cracks; smoke plumes rise from sixty world capitals.
panels.prose_hi: Kaksha se, prithvi khoon bahane wali lal daraaron ke jaal mein fansi hui dikhti hai; vishwa ki saath rajdhaniyon se dhuen ka gubar uthta hai.

panels.shot: in the upper stratosphere: tae-jun fighting in full aegis plate
panels.action: In the thin blue air 50,000 feet up, Kang Tae-Jun slices through fifty flying void hydras with his bronze claymore.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: NOT A SINGLE BEAST TOUCHES THE SURFACE!!

panels.prose_en: In the thin blue air 50,000 feet up, Kang Tae-Jun slices through fifty flying void hydras with his bronze claymore.
panels.prose_hi: 50,000 feet upar patli neeli hawa men, kang Tae-Jun apne kansya clamor ke saath pachas udne wale shunya hydra ko kaatata hai.

panels.shot: section 9 fighter jets screeching through the clouds supporting tae-jun
panels.action: Twelve advanced supersonic fighter jets streak past, firing anti-matter missiles into the beast swarm.
panels.prose_en: Twelve advanced supersonic fighter jets streak past, firing anti-matter missiles into the beast swarm.
panels.prose_hi: Barah unnat supersonic ladaku jet janvaron ke jhund par anti-mater missilen daagte hue aage badhte han.

panels.shot: down over seoul: the 2-mile dreadnought charging main plasma cannon
panels.action: Beneath the clouds, the two-mile dreadnought charges its ventral cannon—a 100-meter barrel glowing with green atomic fire.

dialogue.text: Target: Seoul Metropolitan Sector. Power output: 50 Megatons.

panels.prose_en: Beneath the clouds, the two-mile dreadnought charges its ventral cannon—a 100-meter barrel glowing with green atomic fire.
panels.prose_hi: Badalon ke niche, do meal ka drednot apni udar top ko charge karta hai - hare parmanu aag se chamakti 100 meter ki bairal.

panels.shot: ha-jun floating 200 feet before the charging cannon barrel
panels.action: Ha-Jun hovers weightlessly in front of the colossal glowing barrel, his dark hair whipping in the ionized plasma winds.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Fifty megatons... Agar yeh strike land hui, toh Mapo district ka naam o nishan mit jayega.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hovers weightlessly in front of the colossal glowing barrel, his dark hair whipping in the ionized plasma winds.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun vishal chamakdar barrel ke samne bharahin roop se mandarata hai, uske kale bal aaynit plasma hawaon mein lahra rahe han.

panels.shot: kuro circling overhead his feathers trailing purple lightning
panels.action: Kuro screeches: 'The dreadnought core is protected by an SSS-rank Void Barrier! You need spatial severance!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Fang of Abyss use karo! Slice space itself!

panels.prose_en: Kuro screeches: 'The dreadnought core is protected by an SSS-rank Void Barrier! You need spatial severance!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chillata hai: 'khunkhar core ek sss-rank shunya barrier dwara sanrakshit hai! aapko sthanik prithakkaran ki aavashyakta hai!'

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing the fang of abyss relic into his right hand
panels.action: The Fang of Abyss materializes—a jagged dagger of pure obsidian void-glass that warps the air around its edge.
panels.prose_en: The Fang of Abyss materializes—a jagged dagger of pure obsidian void-glass that warps the air around its edge.
panels.prose_hi: D fang off abis moort roop leta hai - shuddh obsidian shunya-glas ka ek dantedar khanjar jo iske kinare ke charon or hawa ko ghumata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun fusing the fang of abyss into the sanguine fang katana
panels.action: Ha-Jun combines both blades; the Sanguine Fang's blade elongates into a terrifying seven-foot void-katana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun combines both blades; the Sanguine Fang's blade elongates into a terrifying seven-foot void-katana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun donon bledon ko jodta hai; senguin fang ka blade ek bhayanak saat foot ke shunya-katana mein badh jata hai.

panels.shot: the dreadnought ventral cannon firing its 50-megaton green beam
panels.action: A blinding green atomic beam fifty meters wide erupts from the barrel, incinerating clouds in its path toward Saint Mirren.
panels.prose_en: A blinding green atomic beam fifty meters wide erupts from the barrel, incinerating clouds in its path toward Saint Mirren.
panels.prose_hi: Bairal se pachas meter chaudi ek chakachaundh hari parmanu kiran footati hai, jo sent miren ki or apne raste mein aane wale baadalon ko bhasm kar deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun swinging the fused blade in a vertical upward stroke
panels.action: Ha-Jun meets the million-degree beam with a single, upward diagonal slash of his seven-foot blade.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun meets the million-degree beam with a single, upward diagonal slash of his seven-foot blade.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne saat foot ke blade ke ek ekal, upar ki or vikarna slash ke saath milion-degri beam se milta hai.

panels.shot: the 50-megaton beam split cleanly in two like running water
panels.action: The massive green energy beam is cleanly bisected down the center, parting harmlessly around Ha-Jun into the upper clouds.
panels.prose_en: The massive green energy beam is cleanly bisected down the center, parting harmlessly around Ha-Jun into the upper clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal harit urja kiran saf-suthri roop se kendra se neeche ki or vibhajit hoti hai, Ha-Jun ke charon or upari baadalon mein hanirahit roop se vibhajit hoti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun starlight blade wave continuing into the dreadnought hull
panels.action: The crescent shockwave of violet starlight doesn't stop; it travels up into the very prow of the two-mile dreadnought.
panels.prose_en: The crescent shockwave of violet starlight doesn't stop; it travels up into the very prow of the two-mile dreadnought.
panels.prose_hi: Bangni taron ki ardhchandrakar tarang rukti nahin hai; yah do meal khunkhar jahaz ke agle sire tak yatra karta hai.

panels.shot: the two-mile dreadnought bisected cleanly from bow to stern
panels.action: With a deafening groan of shearing titanium armor, the colossal two-mile ship splits cleanly in two halves.

dialogue.text: A two-mile dreadnought... Cleaved with a single swing.

panels.prose_en: With a deafening groan of shearing titanium armor, the colossal two-mile ship splits cleanly in two halves.
panels.prose_hi: Titenium kavach ko kaatne ki gaganbhedi karah ke sath, do meal ka vishal jahaj do hisson mein spasht roop se vibhajit ho jata hai.

panels.shot: internal secondary explosions ripping through both halves of the ship
panels.action: Dozens of internal power reactors detonate inside the severed ship, creating a spectacular chain of orange fireballs.
panels.prose_en: Dozens of internal power reactors detonate inside the severed ship, creating a spectacular chain of orange fireballs.
panels.prose_hi: Tute hue jahaj ke andar darjanon aantarik bijli reactor visfot karte han, jisse narangi aag ke golon ki ek shandar shrinkhala ban jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun invoking eclipse devourer to consume the falling wreckage
panels.action: To protect the university below, Ha-Jun opens a colossal black hole vortex above the campus, swallowing all falling scrap.
panels.prose_en: To protect the university below, Ha-Jun opens a colossal black hole vortex above the campus, swallowing all falling scrap.
panels.prose_hi: Niche vishwavidyalaya ki suraksha ke liye, Ha-Jun parisar ke upar ek vishal black hole bhanwar kholta hai, jo sabhi girte scrap ko nigal jata hai.

panels.shot: not a single piece of flaming debris touching the saint mirren courtyard
panels.action: The courtyard remains pristine; only warm stardust and confetti-like violet embers drift onto the grass.
panels.prose_en: The courtyard remains pristine; only warm stardust and confetti-like violet embers drift onto the grass.
panels.prose_hi: Aangan prachin rahata hai; keval garm stardust aur comfeti jaise baingani angaare ghas par bahte han.

panels.shot: students and faculty cheering wildly from behind the classroom windows
panels.action: Inside the ward, professors and students press against the glass, weeping and shouting Ha-Jun's name in joy.

dialogue.speaker: professor
dialogue.text: He saved us... Kang Ha-Jun saved our entire university!

panels.prose_en: Inside the ward, professors and students press against the glass, weeping and shouting Ha-Jun's name in joy.
panels.prose_hi: Vard ke ander, professor aur chhatra khushi se rote hue aur Ha-Jun ka naam chillate hue, kaanch ke khilaf dabate han.

panels.shot: min-jae giving a triumphant fist pump against the window glass
panels.action: Min-Jae slams his fist against the pane, grinning ear to ear: 'That's my best friend, you alien bastards!!'
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae slams his fist against the pane, grinning ear to ear: 'That's my best friend, you alien bastards!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne falak par apni mutthi patak di aur kaan se kaan tak muskurate hue kaha: 'vah mera sabse acha dost hai, videshi kaminon!!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun hovering in the quiet air catching his breath
panels.action: Ha-Jun floats in the clearing sky, his coat settling smoothly; a drop of sweat traces down his jawline.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun floats in the clearing sky, his coat settling smoothly; a drop of sweat traces down his jawline.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun saaf aakash mein tair raha hai, uska coat sucharu roop se vyavasthit ho raha hai; pasine ki ek boond uski jabde ki rekha se neeche girti hai.

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun shoulder with eyes twitching oddly
panels.action: Kuro lands on his shoulder, but his head twitches unnaturally; faint green static sparks across his feathers.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: H-Ha-Jun... Something... is wrong in my mind...

panels.prose_en: Kuro lands on his shoulder, but his head twitches unnaturally; faint green static sparks across his feathers.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro uske kandhe par baithta hai, lekin uska sir aswabhavik roop se hilta hai; uske pankhon par halki hari sthaitik chingari.

panels.shot: ha-jun turning his head to look at kuro with concern
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at his familiar: 'Kuro? What's wrong? Are you hurt from the blast?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro? Tumhare feathers twitch kyun kar rahe hain?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks at his familiar: 'Kuro? What's wrong? Are you hurt from the blast?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne parichit ki or dekhta hai: 'Kuro? kya galat? kya aap visfot se aahat han?'

panels.shot: kuro ruby eyes flickering into sickly glowing neon-green
panels.action: Kuro's eyes turn from noble crimson to poisonous fluorescent green; a sharp screech escapes his beak.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: SKREEE... The... The Primordial Binding... Nihilux has the ancient whistle!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's eyes turn from noble crimson to poisonous fluorescent green; a sharp screech escapes his beak.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki aankhen lal rang se jahrili fluorescent hari mein badal jaati han; uski chonch se ek tez cheekh nikalti hai.

panels.shot: a horrifying sonic frequency echoing from the dimensional sky
panels.action: High above, Emperor Nihilux blows into an ancient bone whistle carved from the first dragon's spine.
panels.prose_en: High above, Emperor Nihilux blows into an ancient bone whistle carved from the first dragon's spine.
panels.prose_hi: Subse upar, samrat nihilax pehle dragon ki reedh se bani ek prachin haddi ki ct bajata hai.

panels.shot: kuro screaming in agony as dark green runes spread over his wings
panels.action: Kuro thrashes, clutching his head with his talons as ancient void runes burn through his feather shafts.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: HA-JUN!! GET AWAY FROM ME!! I CAN'T HOLD IT!!

panels.prose_en: Kuro thrashes, clutching his head with his talons as ancient void runes burn through his feather shafts.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro dhadkata hai, apne sir ko apne panjon se pakadta hai jaise prachin shunya run uske pankh shaft ke madhyam se jalte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun reaching out to comfort kuro: 'kuro, hold on! i'll purify you!'
panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches both hands out, channeling gentle sovereign healing mana toward his thrashing familiar.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro! Shh, I've got you! Resist it!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches both hands out, channeling gentle sovereign healing mana toward his thrashing familiar.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun donon haath failakar komal samprabhu upchar man ko apne parichit ki or nirdeshit karta hai.

panels.shot: kuro talons suddenly snapping out with blinding supersonic speed
panels.action: Controlled by the whistle, Kuro's diamond talons strike forward like lightning, slashing across Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_en: Controlled by the whistle, Kuro's diamond talons strike forward like lightning, slashing across Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Ct se niyantrit hokar, Kuro ke heere ke panje bijli ki tarah Ha-Jun ki chhati ko paar karte hue aage badhte han.

panels.shot: blood sprays as ha-jun coat and chest are torn open
panels.action: Blood sprays across the clouds; three deep claw wounds rip through Ha-Jun's chest, tearing three Relic seals away.
panels.prose_en: Blood sprays across the clouds; three deep claw wounds rip through Ha-Jun's chest, tearing three Relic seals away.
panels.prose_hi: Badalon par khoon ki bouchharen; teen gahre panje ke ghav Ha-Jun ki chhati ko chirate han, teen avashesh seal ko faad dete han.

panels.shot: the bone, ring, and ashen heart relics falling from ha-jun chest
panels.action: The three basic relics detach from his heart, their light flickering weakly as they tumble toward the ground.
panels.prose_en: The three basic relics detach from his heart, their light flickering weakly as they tumble toward the ground.
panels.prose_hi: Teen mool avashesh uske hriday se alag ho gaye, jab ve jameen ki or gire to unki roshni kamjor roop se timtima rahi thi.

panels.shot: kuro snatching the three relics in his talons flying upward in tears
panels.action: Possessed Kuro clutches the three relics, crying tears of bloody grief as his wings carry him to Nihilux's throne.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: I'm sorry... Ha-Jun... I'm so sorry...

panels.prose_en: Possessed Kuro clutches the three relics, crying tears of bloody grief as his wings carry him to Nihilux's throne.
panels.prose_hi: Kabje mein rakha Kuro teen avsheshon ko pakadta hai, khooni dukh ke aansu rota hai kyonki uske pankh use nihilax ke sinhasan tak le jaate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun falling through the clouds clutching his bleeding chest cliffhanger
panels.action: Wounded and betrayed by cosmic fate, Ha-Jun plunges from the sky toward the ruined city below!

dialogue.text: THE GUARDIAN HAS TURNED. THE SOVEREIGN FALLS.

panels.prose_en: Wounded and betrayed by cosmic fate, Ha-Jun plunges from the sky toward the ruined city below!.
panels.prose_hi: Laukik bhagya se ghayal aur dhokha khaya hua, Ha-Jun aasman se neeche barbad shahar ki or girta hai!
